core/shell@1.0.0.name: shell
core/shell@1.0.0.summary: App frame with sidebar, header and main regions.

agent.use: Root block of any multi-region artifact. Put exactly one nav in `sidebar`.
agent.avoid: Nesting shells.

core/sidebar@1.2.0.name: sidebar
core/sidebar@1.2.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Primary navigation between 3–9 sections. Bind `value` to a state key and read it from content blocks with `visible`.
agent.avoid: More than 9 items; put nested content in tabs instead.

core/dropdown@1.3.0.name: dropdown
core/dropdown@1.3.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Any single choice; scales to long option lists.
agent.avoid: Two options — use a button pair.

agent.use: 2–6 sibling views inside one section.
agent.avoid: Top-level navigation (that is the sidebar's job).

agent.use: One primary per region; labels are verbs.
agent.avoid: Using a button to show state.

agent.use: Search boxes, names, short answers.
agent.avoid: Choices from a known list — use dropdown.

agent.use: Group one topic's content; header actions go in the `actions` slot.
agent.avoid: Cards inside cards.

core/stack@1.0.0.name: stack
core/stack@1.0.0.summary: Lay children out in a row, column or grid.

agent.use: All layout. `columns` switches to an even grid.
agent.avoid: Pixel values; gap is a spacing step.

core/text@1.0.0.name: text
core/text@1.0.0.summary: A run of text in one type style.

agent.use: Headings and prose. Use `$tpl` for text that reads state.
agent.avoid: Long documents; that is a Docs artifact.

agent.use: Status next to a title or row.
agent.avoid: Interactive filters.

agent.use: 3–4 KPIs in a stack with `columns`. Feed `value` with `$count`/`$sum` over data.
agent.avoid: More than 6 in a row.

core/table@1.0.0.name: table
core/table@1.0.0.summary: Rows of records under typed columns.

agent.use: Records; bind `rows` to `$filter` over a data source for interactive filtering.
agent.avoid: Over ~200 rows without paging.

core/page@1.0.0.name: page
core/page@1.0.0.summary: Sidebar-free page with optional header and footer and a reading, wide or full canvas.

agent.use: Choose freely: reading for reports, wide for landing pages, full for tools. Any block may be the root. Navigation is optional.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/section@1.0.0.name: section
core/section@1.0.0.summary: Editorial or hero region with optional title, prose, content and actions.

agent.use: Compose heroes, report chapters and feature sections; actions are ordinary blocks. Avoid adding a card around every section.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/grid@1.0.0.name: grid
core/grid@1.0.0.summary: Responsive equal-column grid that fits its container and stacks on narrow canvases.

columns.description: Maximum column count, a positive integer. Fewer columns render when needed to fit the canvas.

agent.use: Use for galleries, feature cards and dashboards; columns is the maximum, minSize controls when columns fit. Children remain in source order.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/split@1.0.0.name: split
core/split@1.0.0.summary: Two flowing panes with a chosen ratio, stacked in source order on narrow canvases.

agent.use: Use for side-by-side explanation and interaction, image and prose, or input and output. Does not create a sidebar.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/image@1.0.0.name: image
core/image@1.0.0.summary: Accessible image with a semantic aspect ratio, fit and optional caption.

agent.use: Use HTTPS URLs, local / paths or raster data URLs. Provide descriptive alt text; use empty alt only for decoration.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/code@1.0.0.name: code
core/code@1.0.0.summary: Literal source code or structured text; displayed, never executed.

agent.use: Display examples, JSON, logs or source. Content remains literal text even when it contains markup.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

agent.use: Use for instructions, summaries and checklists; items are text, ordered enables numbered steps.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/divider@1.0.0.name: divider
core/divider@1.0.0.summary: Semantic separator between flowing content regions.

agent.use: Separate adjacent topics without wrapping them in cards.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/textarea@1.0.0.name: textarea
core/textarea@1.0.0.summary: Labelled multiline input with public value and change events.

agent.use: Use for notes, drafts and longer answers. Read value or bind it to declared state; change emits {value}.

a11y.keyboard: Native multiline text input: Tab to focus, typing to edit.

core/slider@1.0.0.name: slider
core/slider@1.0.0.summary: Labelled numeric range input with a live value.

agent.use: Use for numeric exploration and simulations; change emits {value}. Native arrow keys adjust by step.

core/checkbox@1.0.0.name: checkbox
core/checkbox@1.0.0.summary: Labelled boolean choice with public checked state.

agent.use: Use for independent options; change emits {checked}. Space toggles the native checkbox.

core/bar-chart@1.0.0.name: bar-chart
core/bar-chart@1.0.0.summary: Responsive horizontal bars with accessible labels and numeric values.

agent.use: Use for comparisons; bind items to data or $map. Values stay visible to assistive technology, including negative values.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/composition@1.0.0.name: composition
core/composition@1.0.0.summary: Reusable document-local composition with typed inputs and a public value output.

agent.use: Define doc.compositions[name] with typed inputs, root, blocks, optional output expression and outputType:{type,enum?}. Use $input inside the definition; read instance.value outside. Definitions expand to ordinary installed blocks; never contain HTML or executable code.

core/link@1.0.0.name: link
core/link@1.0.0.summary: Accessible passive link; executable URL schemes are refused.

agent.use: Use HTTPS/HTTP, local / paths, #anchors or mailto links. Provide meaningful label text.

core/rich-text@1.0.0.name: rich-text
core/rich-text@1.0.0.summary: Structured headings, paragraphs, quotes, lists and inline emphasis without raw HTML.

agent.use: nodes kinds: paragraph, heading (level 2/3/4), quote, list (items, ordered), code. Prose accepts text or runs [{text,bold?,italic?,code?,href?}]. Strings remain literal.

core/text-field@1.0.0.name: text-field
core/text-field@1.0.0.summary: Named text, email or URL field with native form validation.

agent.use: Use inside form with name and required/minLength/maxLength; email and url use browser validity. change emits {value}.

core/number-input@1.0.0.name: number-input
core/number-input@1.0.0.summary: Named numeric field with min/max/step validation; empty value is null.

agent.use: Use for calculations; an empty field emits null. Set name inside form; change emits {value}.

core/date-input@1.0.0.name: date-input
core/date-input@1.0.0.summary: Named date field with native picker and ISO date output.

agent.use: Date values and bounds are YYYY-MM-DD; change emits {value}.

core/choice@1.0.0.name: choice
core/choice@1.0.0.summary: Named radio group with native keyboard navigation and a public selection.

agent.use: Use for one option from a short list; options are [{value,label}]. change emits {value}.

core/multiselect@1.0.0.name: multiselect
core/multiselect@1.0.0.summary: Named multiple selection with native keyboard support and array output.

agent.use: Use for several choices; options are [{value,label}], value is a string array. change emits {value}.

core/form@1.0.0.name: form
core/form@1.0.0.summary: Native validated form; submit emits named field values as strings or arrays of strings.

agent.use: Place named native fields in children. Invalid fields prevent submit. submit emits {values}: string values, duplicate names become arrays. Wire submit to declared state or a host action.

core/scene@1.0.0.name: scene
core/scene@1.0.0.summary: Responsive vector scene assembled from rect/circle/line/path/text geometry and token colors.

agent.use: shapes: {kind:rect|circle|line|path|text,id?,label?,x?,y?,width?,height?,radius?,x2?,y2?,d?,text?,size?,fill?,stroke?,strokeWidth?}. Colors: accent, ink, ink-muted, line, surface, sunken, paper, success, danger; no arbitrary SVG attributes. interactive shapes with id emit select {id} and support Enter/Space.

core/diagram@1.0.0.name: diagram
core/diagram@1.0.0.summary: Node and edge diagram with automatic placement or explicit coordinates.

agent.use: nodes: [{id,label,x?,y?,tone?}], edges: [{from,to,label?}]. Coordinates are optional. interactive nodes emit select {id}.

core/line-chart@1.0.0.name: line-chart
core/line-chart@1.0.0.summary: Responsive numeric X/Y line chart with an accessible data table.

agent.use: items: [{x,y,label?}]. Supply sorted x values for ordered paths. Data is available in a keyboard-accessible table.

core/scatter-chart@1.0.0.name: scatter-chart
core/scatter-chart@1.0.0.summary: Responsive numeric X/Y scatter plot with an accessible data table.

agent.use: items: [{x,y,label?}]. Both axes are numeric; use for correlation and simulations.

core/area-chart@1.0.0.name: area-chart
core/area-chart@1.0.0.summary: Responsive filled area chart of numeric X/Y data with an accessible data table.

agent.use: items: [{x,y,label?}] with sorted x. Use for volume over time; prefer line-chart when several readings overlap.

core/donut-chart@1.1.0.name: donut-chart
core/donut-chart@1.1.0.summary: Part-to-whole ring chart with a legend, percentages and an accessible data table.

agent.use: items: [{label,value}] with positive values, at most 12 slices. Use for part-to-whole with few categories; use bar-chart to compare many. Set interactive to make slices selectable: select emits {label,value,index} and the public output `selected` is the label (empty = none); filter other blocks with $filter on it.

core/gauge@1.0.0.name: gauge
core/gauge@1.0.0.summary: Single value on a half-ring scale between a minimum and maximum.

agent.use: value within min..max (clamped). tone is a token colour. Use for one KPI against a known scale, not for trends.

core/sparkline@1.0.0.name: sparkline
core/sparkline@1.0.0.summary: Tiny inline trend line for a series of numbers; sits next to a stat or in a table cell.

agent.use: values: number[]; no axes. Put beside a stat for trend. Provide a label that states what the series is.

core/heatmap@1.1.0.name: heatmap
core/heatmap@1.1.0.summary: Row by column matrix whose cell shading shows magnitude, with every value readable as text.

agent.use: rows and columns are labels; values[row][column] numbers. Use for intensity across two categories. Missing cells show a dash. interactive makes cells buttons: select emits {row,column,value}; output `selected` is {row,column} or null.

core/alert@1.0.0.name: alert
core/alert@1.0.0.summary: Inline callout for information, success, warning or danger with an optional title and content.

agent.use: tone info|success|warning|danger; title and text, or children. danger and warning announce immediately.

core/accordion@1.0.0.name: accordion
core/accordion@1.0.0.summary: Stack of headings that each reveal a panel; one open at a time with a public value.

agent.use: items: [{id,title,body}]; value is the open id (empty closes all). change emits {value}. Use for FAQs and optional detail.

core/stepper@1.0.0.name: stepper
core/stepper@1.0.0.summary: Ordered progress through named steps; optionally clickable, with the current step public.

agent.use: steps: [{id,label,description?}]; value is the current id. interactive makes steps buttons; change emits {value}. Wire value to state to drive step content with visible.

core/timeline@1.0.0.name: timeline
core/timeline@1.0.0.summary: Chronological list of events with optional times, descriptions and tone.

agent.use: items: [{title,time?,description?,tone?}] in order. Use for history, roadmaps and activity logs.

core/modal@1.0.0.name: modal
core/modal@1.0.0.summary: Dialog layered over the artifact; opened and closed by commands, Escape or the close button.

agent.use: Place content in children. Open with a button command {do:'call',target:modal,command:'open'}; Escape, the backdrop and the close button emit change {open:false}. Use sparingly for confirmations and detail.

core/switch@1.0.0.name: switch
core/switch@1.0.0.summary: Labelled on/off toggle with a public checked state.

agent.use: Use for an immediate on/off setting; change emits {checked}. Use checkbox for form-style choices.

core/combobox@1.0.0.name: combobox
core/combobox@1.0.0.summary: Type-to-filter single choice with a keyboard listbox; the value is always one of the options.

agent.use: Use when the option list is long enough to search. options [{value,label}]; change emits {value}. Free text is not accepted.

core/tree@1.0.0.name: tree
core/tree@1.0.0.summary: Expandable hierarchy with keyboard navigation and a selected node id.

agent.use: nodes: [{id,label,children?}] up to depth 8 and 500 nodes. select emits {id}; arrows move, Right/Left expand and collapse.

core/data-grid@1.0.0.name: data-grid
core/data-grid@1.0.0.summary: Sortable, filterable, paged table whose rows can be selected.

agent.use: columns [{key,label}], rows objects. Sorts, filters (filterable) and pages in place; select emits {row,index} and the selected row is the public output.

core/kanban@1.0.0.name: kanban
core/kanban@1.0.0.summary: Columns of cards that move between columns with buttons; the moved board is public.

agent.use: columns [{id,title}], cards [{id,title,column,description?}]. Buttons move a card; move emits {id,from,to,cards} and the new board is output `board` (null until moved).

core/calendar@1.0.0.name: calendar
core/calendar@1.0.0.summary: Month grid with event dots, month navigation and a selected ISO date.

agent.use: month is YYYY-MM (required, so the render is deterministic). events [{date:YYYY-MM-DD,title}]. change emits {value}; weekStart 0 or 1.

core/carousel@1.0.0.name: carousel
core/carousel@1.0.0.summary: One slide at a time with previous/next, dots and arrow keys; the slide index is public.

agent.use: slides [{title?,text?,src?,alt?}]; image src follows the image block's passive rules. change emits {index}.

core/markdown@1.0.0.name: markdown
core/markdown@1.0.0.summary: Markdown subset (headings, lists, quotes, code, emphasis, links, $math$) rendered as elements, never HTML.

agent.use: Subset only: #-### headings, lists, > quotes, ``` code, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](https://…) and $tex$ / $block$ math. No raw HTML.

core/math@1.0.0.name: math
core/math@1.0.0.summary: TeX math (fractions, roots, scripts and limits, matrices, cases, accents, stretchy delimiters, Greek and symbols) rendered as accessible elements.

agent.use: TeX math, not LaTeX documents: \frac \binom \sqrt[n]{} ^ _ \sum_{i}^{n} \int \lim, \left( \right), \begin{pmatrix|bmatrix|vmatrix|cases|aligned}…\end, \hat \vec \overline, \text{} \mathbb \mathcal \mathbf, Greek and common symbols. display:true stacks limits above and below. Unknown commands render as their name; no macros, no packages.

ledger/sidebar@2.0.0.name: sidebar
ledger/sidebar@2.0.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Grouped nav: set `group` on items for section headers, `code` for 2–4 char tickers.
agent.avoid: Long labels; Ledger truncates at one line.

ledger/dropdown@2.0.0.name: dropdown
ledger/dropdown@2.0.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Segmented control: every option visible, one tap. Up to 6 short options.
agent.avoid: Long or dynamic option lists — pin `core/dropdown@1` for those.

agent.use: Mono uppercase tabs; `count` renders as [n].
agent.avoid: Tab labels over 14 characters.

agent.use: `kbd` shows a keyboard hint (display only).
agent.avoid: Sentence-case labels; Ledger uppercases.

agent.use: Panels in dense grids; `code` is a short panel id like PNL-01.
agent.avoid: Padding-heavy content; bodies sit flush.

agent.use: `trend` (8–30 numbers) draws a sparkline.
agent.avoid: Decorative trends with no data.

atelier/sidebar@1.0.0.name: sidebar
atelier/sidebar@1.0.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Up to 6 items, each may carry a one-line `description`.
agent.avoid: Dense tool navigation — that is Ledger's job.

atelier/dropdown@1.0.0.name: dropdown
atelier/dropdown@1.0.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Chips that wrap; good for 2–10 friendly choices.
agent.avoid: Options over 3 words.

agent.use: Pill switcher for 2–4 views.
agent.avoid: More than 4 tabs.

agent.use: Pill buttons; primary is ink-filled.
agent.avoid: More than one primary per card.

agent.use: `eyebrow` is a short kicker above a serif title; actions sit at the bottom.
agent.avoid: Tables inside Atelier cards on narrow screens.

agent.use: Big serif figure with a sentence `caption`.
agent.avoid: More than 3 per row.
